name: pinshuai-image
changes: Independent product-reference workflow and structured prompt template
Require one output per request; reject multiple response items instead of silently discarding
Do not print raw API image data
Journaled runner with no automatic POST retries
Adjustable reconstruction depth 1-10 (default 5) resolved into prompt guidance and run records; product invariants and user locks remain authoritative
Bare-number conversational depth and CLI shorthand; automatic change planning, per-new-task default 5, context-aware separation from quantity
Explicit batch model selection for three GPT Image and two Gemini image models; omitted model makes no generation request
Local-byte GPT async edits with persisted task IDs and GET-only recovery; preserve generic sync compatibility
Native Gemini inlineData requests, PNG/JPEG/WebP result formats, saved response and deduplicated download recovery
Read-only model availability checks; family-specific parameter validation; no automatic model switching
Add the 21st reconstruction dimension: depth-guided appearance of unlocked human scene participants; protect portrait identity, user locks and product faces; no invented people/faces.

Expression reconstruction follows all ten depths with concrete source/target planning; identity locks do not imply expression locks; protect explicit emotion locks, product character faces and advertising emojis.
Preserve source emotional tone by default at all depths; depth varies expression only within that tone; only explicit user instructions authorize emotional direction changes.

Add a private local casebook for redacted runtime failures and explicitly reviewed visual outcomes; retrieve confirmed cases for future planning, keep recurring patterns as candidate rules, and never auto-train or rewrite general guidance.
First-run third-party setup asks for consent, hides local terminal API-key entry, and only fills missing .env values.
Exclude local installation reports and machine-specific paths from the public release package.
